title: Exact contextuality degrees for disjoint Mermin configurations
peer_review_status: Research preprint (not peer reviewed; AI-assisted under human direction)
author: Alexander Stephen Donahue
core_result: Proves exact arbitrary-copy contextuality degree formulas d_k = (7^k - 5^k)/2 for k disjoint Peres-Mermin squares and (6^k - 4^k)/2 for k Mermin pentagrams under full nonempty-union context families, answering Section 6 of Muller & Saniga (arXiv:2609.19862v1).
